questions.question: The price of bread is Rs.20 more than the price of the jam, the price of bread & jam together cost Rs.22.50. Find the price of the bread.
questions.questionHtml: The price of bread is Rs.20 more than the price of the jam, the price of bread & jam together cost Rs.22.50. Find the price of the bread.
questions.solution:
Let:

The price of bread is = x

The price of jam is = y

As per the given data:

The price of bread is Rs.20 more than the price of the jam.

⇒ (x - y) = 20

The price of bread & jam together cost Rs.22.50.

⇒ (x + y) = 22.5

From these two equations:

⇒ 2x = 42.50

⇒ x = 21.25

The price of bread is = x = 21.25

Hence, the correct answer is "21.25".

questions.question: If 17 December 2012 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 18 November 2020?
questions.questionHtml: If 17 December 2012 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 18 November 2020?
questions.solution:
Given: 17 December 2012 was Monday.

Now,

2012 to 2020 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years).

And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap Years and 6 Ordinary Years.

So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days,

And, 6 Ordinary Years have 6 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.

then, 17 December 2020 will be Monday + 3 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 18 November 2020 to 17 December 2020

= 12 + 17 = 29 days.

= 29 days → 29/7 = 4 weeks and 1 odd days.

The dates are in past, so subtract 1 days from the day on 17 December 2020 which is Thursday

So, 18 November 2020 will be Thursday - 1 = Wednesday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: You are working in as a manager of a company and your girlfriend is an employee in the same company. She is asking you to promote her, you will
questions.questionHtml: You are working in as a manager of a company and your girlfriend is an employee in the same company. She is asking you to promote her, you will

options.text: Refuse her demand as other employees will think that you favored her as she is your girlfriend.
options.html: Refuse her demand as other employees will think that you favored her as she is your girlfriend.

options.text: Promote her as you love her so much and can't deny her demand.
options.html: Promote her as you love her so much and can't deny her demand.

options.text: Evaluate her performance and discuss it with other board members about it.
options.html: Evaluate her performance and discuss it with other board members about it.

options.text: Break relations with her as she is taking benefit of your position.
options.html: Break relations with her as she is taking benefit of your position.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.

Statement Correctness Reasoning
Refuse her demand as other employees will think that you favored her as she is your girlfriend. Incorrect It shows your conservative nature and under confidence. If she deserves a promotion, you should not bother the views of other employees
Promote her as you love her so much and can't deny her demand. Incorrect You should not promote her just because she is your girlfriend. Promotion should be merit-based
Evaluate her performance and discuss it with other board members about it. Correct It shows your sense of responsibility. You should not promote her just because she is your girlfriend. Promotion should be merit-based

Break relations with her as she is taking benefit of your position.

 Incorrect

She is just asking you for a promotion and not forcing you. You should make her understand the process and rules
  • Qualities Projected in this situation:  Sense of Responsibility, Determination, Dedication and Social adaptability.

Key Points

  • Checklist for attempting SRT questions:
  1. Read the question and options carefully.
  2. Look for options that are realistic, optimistic, and reflect officer-like qualities.
  3. Do not skip any situation.
  4. Relegate the negative sentences and choose the most logical option among the remaining. As time is an important factor, hence your thinking ability should be swift.
  5. React quickly and be logical.

questions.question: Direction : In the question below is given a statement followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true, then consider the two conclusions together and decide which of them logically follow beyond a reasonable doubt from the information given in the statement. Statement: Green revolution propelled India from a position of dependent nation to a self-sufficient one in food security. Conclusions: I. Earlier, India used to rely on other nations to ensure food security. II. Green revolution should be adopted by all countries which are yet to attain self-sufficiency in food security.
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: In the question below is given a statement followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true, then consider the two conclusions together and decide which of them logically follow beyond a reasonable doubt from the information given in the statement.

Statement:

Green revolution propelled India from a position of dependent nation to a self-sufficient one in food security.

Conclusions:

I. Earlier, India used to rely on other nations to ensure food security.

II. Green revolution should be adopted by all countries which are yet to attain self-sufficiency in food security.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows
options.html: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows

questions.solution:
• The statement states that the Green revolution helped India attain self-sufficiency in food production.
  • So, it is implied that earlier, we were not self-sufficient and hence conclusion I follows.
  • The effectiveness of the Green revolution in other countries is beyond the scope of the statement. This is because there is no information given about other countries and thus conclusion II does not follow.
  • Hence, only conclusion I follows.

questions.question: What is the total number of digits printed, if a book containing 201 pages is to be numbered from 1 to 201?
questions.questionHtml: What is the total number of digits printed, if a book containing 201 pages is to be numbered from 1 to 201?
questions.solution:
One digit number, 1 to 9 =9

Two digit number, 10 to 99 = 90 × 2 = 180

Three digit number, 100 to 201 = 102 × 3 =306

Total digit = 9 + 180 + 306 = 495

Hence, total digit is 495.

Hence, “neither 1 nor 2” follow.

questions.question: Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number. 59 : 14 :: 61 : 7 :: 37 : ?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

59 : 14 :: 61 : 7 :: 37 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: Sum of the L.H.S number = R.H.S number.

Here,

for 59 : 14

⇒ 59 : 14 \(\Rightarrow\) 5 + 9 = 14

for, 61 : 7

⇒ 61 : 7 \(\Rightarrow\) 6 + 1 = 7

Similarly, for 37 : ?

⇒ 37 ⇒ 3 + 7 = 10.

So, 37 : 10.

Hence, the correct answer is "10".

questions.question: Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. Dermatologist : Skin : Neonatologist : ?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Dermatologist : Skin : Neonatologist : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Dermatologist is a doctor who studies and treats skin diseases.

So Dermatologist is related to Skin.

Similarly,

Neonatologist is a doctor who diagnose and treat newborns baby or Infants.

So Neonatologist is related to Infants.

Hence, "option 2" is the correct answer.

Key Points

  • Neonatology is a subspecialty of pediatrics that consists of the medical care of newborn infants, especially the ill or premature newborns.
  • It is a hospital-based specialty and is usually practiced in neonatal intensive care units.
  • A neonatal intensive care unit (NICU), also known as an intensive care nursery (ICN), is an intensive care unit (ICU) specializing in the care of ill or premature newborn infants.
  • Neonatal refers to the first 28 days of life.
  • Neonatal care, as known as specialized nurseries or intensive care, has been around since the 1960s.
  • The first American newborn intensive care unit, designed by Louis Gluck, was opened in October 1960 at Yale-New Haven Hospital.​

questions.solution:

Sum of digits of first number = Second number

Similarly,

2) 2854 → 2 + 8 + 5 + 4 = 19 ≠ 16

3) 1486 → 1 + 4 + 8 + 6 = 19 ≠ 16

4) 3256 → 3 + 2 + 5 + 6 = 16 = 16

Hence, the correct answer is "3256".
